subject: integration
name: Nostr standard (NOSTR_0_1)
summary: A definition of NOSTR_0_1: reading a Nostr key derived for the site, signEvent (NIP-01 events, BIP-340 signature) and nip44Encrypt and nip44Decrypt, in three groups (risk 3, 8, 8). The definition says every signature and every encrypted message is confirmed by the person, and names a built-in decoder that only writes the confirmation text. The row holds no key and runs no signer; whichever Crypto answers holds the key, and nothing here checks that. Level 4 with privacy: the row connects to nothing. Judged here by its publisher.
